tasks.visibility.title: Who can see this task
tasks.visibility.text: Personal: only you. Family: everyone who may use Tasks. Selected members: only the people you tick (you are always included).

tasks.recurrence.title: Repeat
tasks.recurrence.text: Makes the task come back on its own after you finish it, for example every week. It needs a due date; the next date is worked out from it.

tasks.reminder.title: Reminder
tasks.reminder.text: When you are notified about this task: at the due time or a set time before it. A time before needs a due time.
